top news.title: Bipartisan US House lawmakers introduce the AI Kill Switch Act, which would grant the DHS the authority to shut down or slow AI models that it deems dangerous

tweets.author: @tedlieu
tweets.text: Rep Moran and I introduced the AI Kill Switch Act today. This is urgent, common sense legislation to address the problem of an advanced AI model that has gone rogue and escaped its guardrails (OpenAI / Hugging Face incident) or had insufficient guardrails (Mythos 5 and Fable 5).

tweets.author: @repscottperry
tweets.text: A “Kill Switch” does exactly what it seems - it kills your vehicle/shuts it down...against your will, whenever “it” deems necessary.  No one supports drunk driving - and there are laws to prevent and deal with it.  You don't punish the good for the deeds of the bad.  There's enough outside impact in our lives; we don't need our vehicles making decisions for us now, too.  KILL THE KILL SWITCH.

tweets.author: @adamthierer
tweets.text: Government-mandated “kill switches” have no place in a free society. Will be ripe for abuse. There are better ways to address concerns about AI safety without resorting to the autocrat's toolkit. [image]
